	-DDEVELHELP -Werror -DCPU_FAM_NRF52 -mno-thumb-interwork -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mlittle-endian -mthumb -mfloat-abi=hard -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fshort-enums -ggdb -g3 -Os -DCPU_MODEL_NRF52840XXAA -DCPU_CORE_CORTEX_M4F -DRIOT_APPLICATION=\"hello-world\" -DBOARD_NRF52840DK=\"nrf52840dk\" -DRIOT_BOARD=BOARD_NRF52840DK -DCPU_NRF52=\"nrf52\" -DRIOT_CPU=CPU_NRF52 -fwrapv -Wstrict-overflow -fno-common -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wall -Wextra -Wmissing-include-dirs -fno-delete-null-pointer-checks -fdiagnostics-color -Wstrict-prototypes -Wold-style-definition -gz -Wformat=2 -Wformat-overflow -Wformat-truncation -Wcast-align -DCPU_RAM_BASE=0x20000000 -DCPU_RAM_SIZE=0x40000 -D__int64_t_defined=1 -include '@BINDIR@/riotbuild/riotbuild.h'   -I@RIOTBASE@/examples/basic/hello-world  -I@RIOTBASE@/core/lib/include -I@RIOTBASE@/core/include -I@RIOTBASE@/drivers/include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/nrf52840dk/include -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/nrf52/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/common/nrf52xxxdk/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/common/nrf52/include -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/nrf5x_common/include -I@BUILD_DIR@/nrf5x_nrfx_mdk/nrf52 -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/cortexm_common/include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/libc/include -isystem@BUILD_DIR@/pkg/cmsis/CMSIS/Core/Include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/auto_init/include -I@BINDIR@/preprocessor -MQ '@BINDIR@/stdio/stdio.o' -MD -MP -c -o @BINDIR@/stdio/stdio.o @RIOTBASE@/sys/stdio/stdio.c

"make" -C @RIOTBASE@/sys/stdio_uart

	-DDEVELHELP -Werror -DCPU_FAM_NRF52 -mno-thumb-interwork -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mlittle-endian -mthumb -mfloat-abi=hard -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fshort-enums -ggdb -g3 -Os -DCPU_MODEL_NRF52840XXAA -DCPU_CORE_CORTEX_M4F -DRIOT_APPLICATION=\"hello-world\" -DBOARD_NRF52840DK=\"nrf52840dk\" -DRIOT_BOARD=BOARD_NRF52840DK -DCPU_NRF52=\"nrf52\" -DRIOT_CPU=CPU_NRF52 -fwrapv -Wstrict-overflow -fno-common -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wall -Wextra -Wmissing-include-dirs -fno-delete-null-pointer-checks -fdiagnostics-color -Wstrict-prototypes -Wold-style-definition -gz -Wformat=2 -Wformat-overflow -Wformat-truncation -Wcast-align -DCPU_RAM_BASE=0x20000000 -DCPU_RAM_SIZE=0x40000 -D__int64_t_defined=1 -include '@BINDIR@/riotbuild/riotbuild.h'   -I@RIOTBASE@/examples/basic/hello-world  -I@RIOTBASE@/core/lib/include -I@RIOTBASE@/core/include -I@RIOTBASE@/drivers/include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/nrf52840dk/include -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/nrf52/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/common/nrf52xxxdk/include -I@RIOTBASE@/boards/common/nrf52/include -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/nrf5x_common/include -I@BUILD_DIR@/nrf5x_nrfx_mdk/nrf52 -I@RIOTBASE@/cpu/cortexm_common/include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/libc/include -isystem@BUILD_DIR@/pkg/cmsis/CMSIS/Core/Include -I@RIOTBASE@/sys/auto_init/include -I@BINDIR@/preprocessor -MQ '@BINDIR@/stdio_uart/stdio_uart.o' -MD -MP -c -o @BINDIR@/stdio_uart/stdio_uart.o @RIOTBASE@/sys/stdio_uart/stdio_uart.c

arm-none-eabi-gcc $(find @BINDIR@/application_hello-world/ @BINDIR@/auto_init/ @BINDIR@/board/ @BINDIR@/board_common_init/ @BINDIR@/boards_common_nrf52xxxdk/ @BINDIR@/core/ @BINDIR@/cortexm_common/ @BINDIR@/cortexm_common_periph/ @BINDIR@/cpu/ @BINDIR@/cpu_common/ @BINDIR@/div/ @BINDIR@/libc/ @BINDIR@/malloc_thread_safe/ @BINDIR@/mpaland-printf/ @BINDIR@/newlib_syscalls_default/ @BINDIR@/nrf52_vectors/ @BINDIR@/nrf5x_common_periph/ @BINDIR@/periph/ @BINDIR@/preprocessor/ @BINDIR@/stdio/ @BINDIR@/stdio_uart/ @BINDIR@/sys/ @BINDIR@/core_lib/ @BINDIR@/periph_common/ -name "*.o" 2> /dev/null | sort)  -lm -L@RIOTBASE@/cpu/nrf52/ldscripts -L@RIOTBASE@/cpu/cortexm_common/ldscripts -Tcortexm.ld -Wl,--fatal-warnings -mcpu=cortex-m4 -mlittle-endian -mthumb -mfloat-abi=hard -mfpu=fpv4-sp-d16 -ggdb -g3 -Os -static -lgcc -nostartfiles -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--defsym=_rom_start_addr=0x00000000 -Wl,--defsym=_ram_start_addr=0x20000000 -Wl,--defsym=_rom_length=0x100000 -Wl,--defsym=_ram_length=0x40000   -L@RIOTBASE@/core/ldscripts -Wl,-wrap=malloc -Wl,-wrap=calloc -Wl,-wrap=realloc -Wl,-wrap=free -lc -Wl,-wrap=__assert_func -Wl,--defsym=_slot_aux_offset=1048576 -Wl,--defsym=_slot_aux_len=0 -Wl,-wrap=printf -Wl,-wrap=fprintf -Wl,-wrap=dprintf -Wl,-wrap=sprintf -Wl,-wrap=snprintf -Wl,-wrap=vprintf -Wl,-wrap=vfprintf -Wl,-wrap=vdprintf -Wl,-wrap=vsprintf -Wl,-wrap=vsnprintf -Wl,-wrap=putchar -Wl,-wrap=putc -Wl,-wrap=fputc -Wl,-wrap=puts -Wl,-wrap=fputs -Wl,-wrap=_printf_common -Wl,-wrap=_fprintf_r -Wl,-wrap=_printf_r -Wl,-wrap=iprintf -Wl,-wrap=fiprintf -Wl,-Map=@BINDIR@/hello-world.map -o @BINDIR@/hello-world.elf

arm-none-eabi-size  @BINDIR@/hello-world.elf
[ -z "auto_init board board_common_init boards_common_nrf52xxxdk core cortexm_common cortexm_common_periph cpu cpu_common div libc malloc_thread_safe mpaland-printf newlib_syscalls_default nrf52_vectors nrf5x_common_periph periph preprocessor stdio stdio_uart sys core_lib periph_common" ] || \
(/usr/bin/env echo "Error - using unknown modules: auto_init board board_common_init boards_common_nrf52xxxdk core cortexm_common cortexm_common_periph cpu cpu_common div libc malloc_thread_safe mpaland-printf newlib_syscalls_default nrf52_vectors nrf5x_common_periph periph preprocessor stdio stdio_uart sys core_lib periph_common" && false)
rm -f @BINDIR@/.test
if grep -q -i "^ $" @RIOTBASE@/dist/usb_id_testing; then \
	/usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo "("Private testing pid.codes USB VID/PID used!, do not" "use it outside of test environments!")" | sed -e 's/^(\|)$//g' 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; \
	/usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo "("MUST NOT be used on any device redistributed," "sold or manufactured, VID/PID is not unique!")" | sed -e 's/^(\|)$//g' 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; \
fi
if [ " " = "1209 7d00" ]; then \
	/usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo "("RIOT standard peripherals code \(1209/7D00\) cannot be set explicitly.")" | sed -e 's/^(\|)$//g' 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; \
	/usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo "("Unset USB_VID / USB_PID for the code to be picked automatically, or set")" | sed -e 's/^(\|)$//g' 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; \
	/usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo "("them to \${USB_VID_TESTING} / \${USB_PID_TESTING} during development.")" | sed -e 's/^(\|)$//g' 1>&2; /usr/bin/env echo -n "" 1>&2; \
	exit 1; \
fi
